entities.summary: Francisco de Asís Vidal y Barraquer was a Spanish Catalan cardinal of the Roman Catholic Church who served as Metropolitan Archbishop of Tarragona and Primate of Spain from 1919 until his death; he was elevated to the rank of cardinal in 1921.
